name: Model of the Watt Steam Engine with animation
creator: Virtual Museums of Małopolska (@WirtualneMuzeaMalopolski)
modifications: Re-encoded with EXT_meshopt_compression; textures resized to 1024 px WebP.
educationalRole: Discovery → আবিষ্কার ও আবিষ্কারক → বাষ্পীয় ইঞ্জিন: a digitised c. 1835 Paris teaching model of a Watt beam engine (Eugène Bourdon, Muzea Małopolski), with its flywheel animation.
limitations: A desk-sized demonstration model, not a full-size factory engine.
The museum display table was removed; textures reduced to 1024 px WebP.
